name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer advancing its flagship Diablillos project, one of the world's largest undeveloped, fully-permitted silver-gold projects located in the Puna region of Salta Province, northern Argentina. A 2026 Definitive Feasibility Study confirmed a base case NPV of US$3.0 billion with a 41.9% IRR and a 25-year mine life, positioning the company as a near-term silver producer.
